title: British Museum collection record for Maqdala slippers Af1868,1001.6.a-b
author: British Museum

notes.text: Verified against web-indexed official catalogue text on 3 October 2026 for A Short History of Taking Things and Keeping Them. Relevant locators: Curator's comments; Acquisition notes. The catalogue explicitly connects the purchase to the Army sale of loot on the Delanta Plain, 20–21 April 1868, and describes Richard Holmes's participation in plundering as the British Museum's representative. The exhibition interest is the coexistence of administrative purchase terminology and acknowledged plunder, not an allegation that the record hides the violence. The dates belong to the acquisition history, not the webpage. The catalogue is registered as a documentary source; this source-only pass creates no displaced-object record or object claims. Direct web retrieval returned HTTP 403; official indexed text was usable. No complete-page redistribution licence or publishable image has been established, so no full capture or image is registered.
